thread:
Toni: Kickoff: HelioHealth customer case + launch webinar. Need interview times, a short benchmark stat for the blog, final quote approval from their Head of Data, and legal embargo date. Can we land this by next Thu?

Raj: I can schedule interviews. Prefer Tue/Wed 30m windows midday PT. @toni which day works for your calendar?

Emily: Quick ask on benchmark: run a 15-minute end-to-end latency/throughput sweep on their anonymized prompt set in staging. Well extract median token latency and a single comparative line for the post. Need customer ok to run tests.

Brandon: Asset list: final quote (signed off), 2 headshots, logo files, and a 60second testimonial clip. I can draft social captions after quote final.

Toni: Draft quote for review:
```
"Redwoodhelped us cut response times so our care coordinators can close cases faster."
```

legal-bot: Suggest replace subjective phrasing. Add attribution "in our tests" for any performance stat. Also remove language implying regulatory impact. Typical review 48hours for short copy.

Toni: Updated: "In our tests, Redwood reduced response times, helping our care coordinators close cases faster." Please confirm.

legal-bot: OK with edit but prefer "in our environment" to avoid absolutes. Final suggestion: "In our tests, Redwood reduced response times in our environment, helping our care coordinators close cases faster." Approved pending no PHI in the transcript.

Emily: Perf run scheduled Wed 08:00 PT. Will post a one-line stat and a short appendix link here once complete.

Raj: Booked Head of Data for Wed 11:00 PT and Product Lead for Wed 11:30 PT. Sent invites with media consent checkbox and embargo note.

ops-bot: Lead routing: utm_campaign=helio_launch; tag=helio-case; routing to /queues/enterprise-sdr. Consent flag saved as consent_marketing=true.

Brandon: Uploaded hero image drafts and placeholder social frames. Holding until quote + headshots.

Emily: Results: median token latency 85ms vs 240ms baseline -> "~2.8x median latency improvement in our tests." Appendix: https://internal/bench/helio-1761112222. Recommend single-line: "~2.8x median latency improvement (our tests)."

Toni: Great. Legal, can we include that phrasing with appendix link?

legal-bot: Yes include with "in our tests" attribution and link to appendix; add methodology blurb on landing page. Embargo requested by customer until 15th  legal set to review final packaging by Fri.

Raj: Customer requested one small edit: change "care coordinators" -> "care teams." Updated quote approved over DM.

Toni: Final quote: "In our tests, Redwood reduced response times in our environment, helping our care teams close cases faster." Good to go?

legal-bot: Approved. Marking green pending no external redlines.

Brandon: Will queue social + webinar creative for scheduling; won't publish until 15th embargo lift.

Toni: Summary: schedule done (Raj), perf stat + appendix (Emily), legal OK (legal-bot), assets pending (Brandon), lead routing set (ops-bot). Follow up Mon for final confirmations.

Raj: I'll attach transcripts after interviews and ping for final quote signoff.

Toni: Thanks team.
